title: Divisibility phenomena in motivic Bloch--Ogus theory
summary: Let X be a smooth projective variety over a field k. For k separably closed, we prove that the subgroup of unramified classes in the Milnor K-group $K^M_i(k(X))$ of the function field of X is contained in the subgroup of n-divisible elements of $K^M_i(k(X))$ for any integer n invertible in k. This generalizes to a statement for unramified motivic cohomology of arbitrary bidegree. We further show that whenever k is finite or separably closed and l is a prime invertible in k, then all but the last step in the Bloch--Ogus filtration of the motivic cohomology of X are l-divisible up to torsion.…
